claims.text: The source conjectures minimality of both generating sets for \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\), and reports verification only for \(r\le4,\ n-r\le5\). [source-2@L1495-L1502|claim=formal-document]

For \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), and \(i=j=m\), the source states that \(a=b=m\) and, conditional on that conjecture, \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) requires \(\binom{2m}{m}\) generators. [source-2@L1508-L1515|claim=formal-document]

**New conditional consequence.** Assuming the cited minimality conjecture, this family satisfies the explicit nonasymptotic bound \[ g(J_{v_{2m,s,t,4m}})\ge \frac{2^{\,n/2}}{\sqrt n}\qquad(n=4m,\ m\ge1), \] where \(g(J)\) is the minimum cardinality of a generating set.
